409.description: host_seat.taken — another local user holds the seat.

peaks.description: JSON array of AUDIO_PEAK_COUNT values in 0–1.

info.title: QuizDock API
info.description: API REST du builder de quiz et des restitutions

UserRole.description: Rôles du compte. Ensemble vide = participant ; `[admin, host]` gère ET anime (RG-14).

roles.description: Rôles du compte. Ensemble vide = participant ; `[admin, host]` gère ET anime (RG-14).

subject.description: Sujet stable du compte (`sub` OIDC, ou `local:<slug>`) — c'est ce qu'un opérateur donne à `user:set-role`.

holder.description: Display name of the current seat holder, or null when the seat is free (always null in OIDC mode).

expiresAt.description: When the seat frees itself automatically; null = no expiry (or free seat).

claimedAt.description: When the holder took or renewed the seat (lets a client renew for the same duration); null when free.

released.description: True when the caller held the seat and it is now free.

publicUrl.description: APP_PUBLIC_URL when configured — the address of a real deployment.

lanIps.description: LAN IPv4 addresses of the machine (bare IPs; the browser adds its own scheme and port). From HOST_LAN_IPS when set, else detected.

lanSource.description: How the LAN addresses were obtained: "configured" (HOST_LAN_IPS), "detected" (host interfaces), or "hidden" (the process only sees a container bridge — Docker Desktop, bridge network).
